scene: The metallic octopus chirps, spinning open exits to the bustling city.
picture: A flat side view of the retro diner lounge. Far left stands a patterned brass revolving door. Left sits the player in her red bomber jacket and roller skates on a diner stool. Centre, a neon pink escalator ascends through the ceiling. Right is the happy brass octopus. Far right, an open noodle-cart monorail waits.
